text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd at the Yasuda Kinen is even more riled up than usual. They're expecting a lot from Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She meets her fans' cheers with a gracious smile, but Hishi Amazon notices there's something off about her.
